visual.context: This is visible warning text printed on the gift card packaging, not an independent allegation about the video creator.

visual.limitations: The frames do not show anyone requesting payment with the card, directing viewers to use the code outside Amazon, or describing any transaction outcome.

The like-and-subscribe request is ordinary channel engagement, and the described material shows no payment request, credential collection, investment, or off-platform transaction. The warning text on the card is presented as packaging text rather than as evidence of a separate scam solicitation.
